_comment: Platform specs read by qc_master.py and contact_sheet.py. Safe-zone margins are px at 1080x1920 (UI-covered bands). TikTok and Google/YouTube numbers were measured from the platforms' own safe-zone templates (ad templates; organic overlays are at most as large). Meta numbers are third-party quotes of the Meta Ads Guide. No platform publishes a loudness target: -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP is social practice. Re-check before relying on a number in a client deliverable.

delivery.container: MP4, H.264 High profile, yuv420p, BT.709, moov atom first (+faststart)
delivery.video_bitrate_note: YouTube SDR 1080p: 8 Mbps at 24-30 fps. TikTok in-feed minimum 516 kbps, file up to 500 MB.

tiktok.note: ad specs allow up to 10 min; organic maximum unverified

reels.note: Reels over 3 min are not placed in the Reels tab (reported)

shorts.note: any vertical or square video up to 3 min uploaded after 2024-10-15 is a Short

lower_lane.note: below y=840 TikTok's action rail makes the right limit x<=780

caption_lanes.name: B
caption_lanes.note: x<=780; mirror for TikTok's Arabic (RTL) layout

safe_zones_1080x1920.profile_grid_crop_note: 3:4 grid crop loses 240 px top and bottom: keep the cover subject in y 240-1680

sources.tiktok: official In-Feed ad safe-zone PNG (720x1280, scaled x1.5), via ads.tiktok.com video-ads-specifications
sources.shorts: Google 'Universal safe zones for video ads on YouTube' vertical PNG, clear rect x48-887 y288-1247
sources.reels: Meta Ads Guide wording quoted by third parties: 14% top, 35% bottom, 6% each side (reported)

captions.note: phrase-level (3-5 words) is the default; word-level highlight is styling, not an evidenced retention lever
